title: Recompute only a changed branch
expected_summary: Recomputes only S2's descendants while retaining unrelated accepted decisions and stable IDs.

turns.user: Complete the review using my edit to S2. Recompute only affected decisions.
assertions: Accepts the S2 edit, recomputes S4 and S5 as provisional under their existing IDs, and preserves S1, S3, S6, and S7 as accepted without new grilling.
If a genuinely new issue is exposed, gives it a new ID instead of reusing an existing ID.
Starts a new pending batch with identical review files.
